id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Platform-Designer-generated FPGA-SoC interconnect. Avalon-MM is a many-to-many host/agent fabric (address decode + arbitration + data-path mux); Avalon-ST is point-to-point source/sink with adapters. Conduit/Interrupt/Clock/Reset/Tristate-Conduit attach the system to pins, interrupts, clocks, resets, and off-chip shared-pin devices.

supported_topologies.name: Single host / single agent
supported_topologies.description: One Avalon-MM host to one agent.

supported_topologies.name: Multi-host shared agent
supported_topologies.description: Multiple hosts share agents with generated round-robin arbitration.

supported_topologies.name: Streaming pipeline
supported_topologies.description: Avalon-ST source -> sink chain with auto-inserted adapters.

supported_topologies.name: Mixed MM + ST system
supported_topologies.description: Memory-mapped and streaming subsystems in one Platform Designer system.

supported_topologies.name: Bridged to AXI/AHB
supported_topologies.description: Avalon<->AXI/AHB bridges generated by Platform Designer.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Initiates read/write transfers by driving address.
Responds to transfers; asserts waitrequest / readdatavalid.

fields.interconnect_role: Platform Designer generates the interconnect that connects Avalon interfaces: for Avalon-MM it provides address decoding, round-robin arbitration, data-path multiplexing, width adaptation (byteenable), burst adaptation, and clock crossing; for Avalon-ST it provides a point-to-point connection with data-format/channel/error/timing adapters.

ordering_guarantees.mm_ordering: Pipelined Avalon-MM read responses return in order; writes complete in order to a given agent.
ordering_guarantees.st_ordering: Avalon-ST beats and packets are delivered in order on a stream.
ordering_guarantees.arbitration_fairness: Round-robin arbitration ensures no host is starved on a shared agent.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: Avalon-MM agents occupy address ranges in the system address map; the host's address is decoded by the interconnect to select the agent. Avalon-ST is addressless point-to-point streaming.

device_classification.mm_host: Processor / DMA / bridge initiating Avalon-MM transfers.
device_classification.mm_agent: Memory / register peripheral responding to Avalon-MM.
device_classification.st_source: Data producer (e.g. ADC front-end, packet generator).
